author: Jacob
text: Brian is a great guy and knowledgeable in his craft. Had to have an emergency pump out after 5pm on Friday due to a pump failure. I told him we had a birthday party the next day and he saved the party! I will only ever use BDS and recommend him.

author: heather wharff
text:
I can’t say enough about BDS septic service.
To start with the basics, he was early , extremely courteous , very patient with my children who would not leave him alone not only did his job, but took the time to teach my son about everything and how it works, he stayed within budget and because of his expertise was able to Quickly, identify the issue with my system and resolve it in a timely manner, both saving time and money for me

It was obvious that because of his experience, he was able to complete the job without leaving a wake of destruction on my property. He was able to pinpoint exactly where he needed to dig and what to do so when he left, it was like he was never there,  that was reassuring.

What a relief it was to have this stressful situation handled by a professional, who was able to resolve our issue right before Thanksgiving literally saving our Holiday

Do not hesitate to call he will be there for you

author: Maya McLean
text: Super nice guy. Communicated very well, came all the way out to the middle of nowhere to help us, and even made a second trip when we realized we didn’t have the equipment we needed. Very old school sort of integrity and work ethic. I’d recommend him to anybody

author: Kyle Marsh
text: Highly recommend BDS Septic Service. Brian was upfront, honest, and offered a wealth of knowledge throughout the process. Pricing was affordable, and the service was professional from start to finish.

author: Emily Smith
text:
The worker Addisen was very helpful throughout the payment and was so patient while we couldn't figure it out. Hopefully everyone gets to meet her she brightened our day with her positivity
No more sewage problems is a plus too!
